language.heading: Language
language.desc: Choose the language used to display the app

displayUnit.heading: Display units
displayUnit.desc: Choose the distance/speed unit shown throughout the app

monthlyGoal.heading: Monthly goal
monthlyGoal.desc: Set a monthly distance goal to see a progress bar on the home page. Leave blank for no goal.

nutritionProfile.heading: Nutrition profile
nutritionProfile.desc: Fill this in to automatically calculate your calories, macros, and daily water target. See the results on the <link>Insights</link> page.

healthFlags.heading: Health flags
healthFlags.desc: Check these based on your blood test results, so the app can warn you when logging foods to watch out for

emailLogin.heading: Sign in with email + password
emailLogin.desc: Set a password as a backup way to sign in with email instead of tapping "Sign in with Google" every time

google.heading: Link Google account

errors.denied: You declined on Google's consent screen
errors.invalidState: The connection session expired — try again
errors.noProfile: Couldn't fetch your profile from Google
errors.exchangeFailed: Couldn't connect to Google (the link may have expired or already been used) — try again
errors.sessionChanged: Your session changed during the connection — try again
errors.linkedElsewhere: This Google account is already linked to a different MooPaTa account — contact support if you want to merge accounts

google.alreadyLinked: Google account already linked — you can sign in with the "Sign in with Google" button on the home page
google.notLinkedDesc: Link a Google account to this account so you can sign in with the Google button without creating a new account

deleteAccount.heading: Delete account
deleteAccount.desc: Permanently delete your account and all your activity data from MooPaTa. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.confirm: Permanently delete your account? All your activity data in MooPaTa will be deleted and cannot be recovered.

profile.heading: Profile
profile.saveNameFailed: Couldn't save your name — try again
profile.uploadFailed: Couldn't upload the photo — use a jpg/png/webp file up to 4MB
profile.removeFailed: Couldn't remove the photo — try again

nutritionProfileForm.fillAllFields: Fill in every field before saving

macroPreferencesForm.intro: Only protein and fat can be adjusted — carbs are always calculated from the remaining calories, so it always adds up to 100% no matter where you set them, and the full adjustable range stays within a safe zone.
macroPreferencesForm.dailyEstimate: Daily estimate (see the exact numbers on the Insights page after saving)
macroPreferencesForm.tip1: The defaults already suit most people — you don't have to adjust anything
macroPreferencesForm.tip2: Want more energy from carbs (e.g. focused on running/cardio)? → lower fat, carbs increase automatically
macroPreferencesForm.tip3: Want to focus on building/maintaining muscle? → raise protein

cholesterol.label: High cholesterol/LDL
cholesterol.hint: Shows today's cholesterol total against a 300mg ceiling on the food diary page

uricAcid.label: High uric acid
uricAcid.hint: Warns when logging high-purine foods, e.g. organ meats, red meat, some seafood, beer

healthFlagsForm.disclaimer: Just a general rule-of-thumb reminder, not a medical diagnosis — check with your doctor too

setPasswordForm.emailTaken: This email is already used by another account
setPasswordForm.invalidPassword: Password must be at least 8 characters
setPasswordForm.notVerified: Not verified yet — check your email
